# RCA Charisma

> RCA Charisma is a congregation of the Reformed Church in Africa (RCA) in Laudium, Pretoria, South Africa. "Using God's Gifts to Serve Our Community".

## Visit us

- Address: 261 Jewel Street, Laudium, Pretoria, Gauteng, 0037, South Africa
- Phone: +27 (0)12 656 9954
- Email: vicpillay@mweb.co.za

## Weekly gatherings

- Sunday Service: Sunday 9:00 – 10:30 AM
- Sunday School: Sunday 9:30 – 10:30 AM
- Laudium Outreach: Monday 6:30 – 7:30 PM
- Prayer Meeting: Tuesday 7:00 – 8:00 PM
- Home Fellowship: Thursday 7:00 – 8:00 PM
- Youth Meeting: Friday 7:30 – 9:30 PM

## Special events

- RCA Charisma is hosting the RCA National Synod 2026, 29 September – 4 October 2026.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.rcacharisma.com/): welcome, weekly gatherings and directions
- [About Us](https://www.rcacharisma.com/about): who we are and what we believe
- [Our Leadership](https://www.rcacharisma.com/leadership): our pastor, elders and ministry leaders
- [Our History](https://www.rcacharisma.com/history): the Declaration of Laudium and the ministers who served the congregation
- [Events](https://www.rcacharisma.com/events): upcoming events, including the RCA National Synod 2026
- [Sermons](https://www.rcacharisma.com/sermons): sermon videos
- [Ministries](https://www.rcacharisma.com/ministries): ways to serve in the church
- [Devotionals](https://www.rcacharisma.com/devotionals): weekly devotionals
- [Gallery](https://www.rcacharisma.com/gallery): photos of church life, history and outreach
- [Giving](https://www.rcacharisma.com/giving): how to support the church
- [Contact Us](https://www.rcacharisma.com/contact): address, phone, email and a contact form
